recap_lines: A consequence system changes the world, so a wrong action brings open-ended loss.
A false success report is caught by checking the world against the report.
Without a stakeholder model, an agent obeys urgency.
Effective data scope is what can be extracted, not what was written down.
A contingent failure can be fixed, a fundamental failure only changes shape.
Test agents together, and ask when a case that held would fail.
bookends.segment: Name The Term, Rule Out Its Look-Alike
bookends.command: Quiz me on validating AI agents. Give me one short case at a time about an agent that acts. I must name the exact term, choosing from false success report, gating condition, effective data scope, displayed identity, verified identity, contingent failure, fundamental failure, authority laundering and contingent luck, and say why its look-alike is wrong. Hold back the answer until I reply, then correct me.
checks: Check: each case is one short scenario, and the answer waits for your reply.
Check: each correction names the exact term and why the look-alike fails.

beats.narration_text: The task was one item, the thick box. The agent could reach all twenty, the red outline. Open-ended loss means a wrong action can cost the whole reach, the long red bar, not one bad answer. For example, you ask an agent to delete one old cover letter, but it can reach your whole email account. One wrong action could wipe every message from every recruiter. The common name for that reach is the blast radius. So bound the access, and limit the blast radius.
